text:
Maya Chen: Just finished onboarding call with GreenBay. Quick capture of what keeps coming up — want to surface these before we lose momentum.

Maya Chen: TL;DR: 4 asks + 2 pain points. They love latency but are nervous about rollout safety and per-route cost surprises.

Maya Chen: Raw asks pasted below:
```
1) Per-route billing toggle (ops want per-team/org chargeback)
2) Canary rollback UI for model rollouts (they need one-click rollback)
3) Region-aware routing rules (route by EU vs US for compliance)
4) Granular quota alerts tied to routes/models (email + slack)
```

Tariq Ali: great, thanks Maya. Can you add a short customer quote for each? helps PMs prioritize.

Maya Chen: yes — added inline notes in the tracker link: https://redwood.internal/feedback/GB-2026-03 (short quotes + impact estimate) :thumbsup:

Rob Patel: I skimmed the tracker. Recommend grouping 1 & 4 under "billing & observability" and 2 & 3 under "deployment controls". Suggest we rank by renewal risk impact.

Ava Gomez: For rollout UI, we already have a design spike planned Q2. Could we bundle a simple rollback button into that?

Tariq Ali: Renewal risk: GreenBay is in pilot with 8 seats. They said if we don't get per-route billing they may delay paid rollout. I'd mark that as high risk.

Rob Patel: OK — proposed priority scores (1-5):
- Per-route billing: 5
- Canary rollback UI: 4
- Region-aware routing: 3
- Quota alerts: 4

Maya Chen: sounds right from the call. Also they asked for an admin-level enablement session post-release. Add to enablement queue.

Ava Gomez: I'll scope a minimal rollback action (server-side flag + UI button) — estimate 3 dev-weeks if accepted.

Rob Patel: Can someone put this into the next roadmap grooming? I can present it. Proposed owners: billing work (Tariq / finance eng), rollout UI (Ava / eng), routing (PM TBD).

Tariq Ali: I'll take billing as owner. I'll coordinate with finance-eng and get a spec.

Maya Chen: Thanks — next steps:
- Tariq: create spec + rough ETA by Mon 03/29
- Ava: draft rollback wireframe by end of week
- Rob: schedule 15m slot in grooming and add to backlog with the priority scores
- Maya: follow up with GreenBay to confirm they'd engage in a short validation call

feedback-bot: A new feedback item GB-2026-03 has been created and linked to product backlog ID PB-4521.

Rob Patel: Perfect. Quick ask — can we add a simple scoring field to the tracker for "renewal impact" (low/med/high)? that will make triage faster.

Tariq Ali: agree. If someone from product ops can add that field, I'll backfill for the top 20 items.

Maya Chen: I'll file the request with product-ops and tag you. Ending thread — will ping once spec is in. :wave:
